fields.description: Program Description Course Introduction 1. Training Goal Editor Notes: This program is open to international students intending to pursue the science and practice of medicine. Aims to nurture high-caliber medical graduates with solid medical knowledge, competent clinical skills, and professionalism. Have the ability to work in medical and health institutions. Make meaningful contributions to the areas of patient care, education, and research. Emphasis on technical skills, interdisciplinary studies, and clinical practice. 2. Main Courses Editor Notes: There are three main categories -- as well as 16 main courses for the program. Curriculum (for reference only) Course Categories Course Chinese Culture & Natural Science Courses Brief Introduction to China Chinese Language Medical Chinese Mathematics Physics Chemistry Biological Sciences Computers Organic Chemistry Liberal Arts & Basic Medicine Courses Histoembryology Anatomy Cell Biology Genetics Physiology Biochemistry and Molecular Biology Immunology Microbiology Parasitology Pathophysiology Pathology Medical Ethics Pharmacology Clinical Medicine Courses Diagnostics Diagnostic Imaging Medicine Surgery Obstetrics and Gynecology Pediatrics Preventive Medicine Epidemiology Medical Psychology Psychiatry Neurology Dermatology Oncology Ophthalmology Otolaryngology Stomatology Forensic Medicine Traditional Chinese Medicine 3. Internship Information Editor Notes: Students will have the opportunity to participate in overseas clinical internship programs. The internship starts in the last 1 year. 11 affiliated hospitals, of which eight are level three first-class hospitals.. Have the opportunity to participate in overseas clinical internship programs. The tuition for the internship year is still RMB 75,000/year. 4. Degree Awarded You'll be shown how the MBBS Degree is awarded and what you should do after obtaining your MBBS degree MBBS Degree Awarded: After completing the required number of credits, students will be conferred a diploma from Fudan University, and qualified students will receive a degree of Bachelor of Medicine and the Bachelor of Surgery (MBBS). After Obtaining MBBS Degree: Graduates will have the opportunity to register for medical licensing exams in accordance with the requirements of the relevant regulatory bodies of the countries in which they choose to practice. School Introduction 5. Brief Introduction to Fudan University Fudan University was established in 1905 as Fudan Public School. As one of the first participants in the 211 and 985 Projects, Fudan has developed into a comprehensive research university, with Departments of Philosophy, Economics, Law, Education, Literature, History, Science, Engineering, Medicine, and Management. After years of exploring and practicing, Fudan has now established its own curriculum and management system, both of which are unique and progressively improving. Learn More about Fudan University 6. About International Students Office(ISO) Take the charge of management and coordination of admission for international degree and non-degree students. Be responsibale for visa processing, residence permit application, insurance affairs. The duty of ISO is researching and drafting management policies regarding international students, management of the International Students Dormitory.

fields.materials: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. Application Form * 2. Proof of Non-Criminal Record * 3. Two letters of recommendation in Chinese or English from whom can attest to the quality of the applicant’s academic performance and scholastic potential. The letters must include recommenders’ phone number and email address.If the letters cannot be uploaded by the applicant, the applicant can send the link in the system to the recommender for filling in the letter. 4. Other materials Applicants may submit additional documents which may demonstrate comprehensive abilities along with the required documents, such as award certificates o rpublished papers. * 5. English proficiency test certificate Original or notarized copyof TOEFL (IBT) score of 90 or above or IELTS (Academic) score 6.5 or above or Duolingo score of 110 or above or PTE Academic score of 61 or above, taken within two years prior to application date (only for applicants from non-English speaking countries), students from high school with major courses taught in English maybe waiveredof TOEFLor IELTS requirements. * 6. High School Full Transcript Original or notarized copy, with notarized Chinese or English translation, if original not in Chinese or English. * 7. High School Diploma Applicants in their final year of high school study shall provide the expected graduation certificate(Original or notarized copy, with notarized Chinese or English translation, if original not in Chinese or English). * 8. Photocopy of valid passport identification page. Only ordinary passports are accepted and the expiry date should be after March1, 2027. * 9. Passport-sized photos Three passport-sized photos (photo must have been taken within the past six months. * 10. Statement of personal financial capacity or financial support You can download a template or sample from here . * 11. CSCA Test Transcript(s) -You need to take the official CSCA test organized by the Chinese government and submit the corresponding subject result transcript(s) when applying. Learn more about the CSCA test >> -The test covers Chinese (Humanities and STEM Chinese), Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry. Mathematics is required for all programs, while other subjects depend on the university’s specific requirements. -We are updating detailed information for each university, including the required subjects you have to take for each program and their score requirements. Once the updates are ready, you can check the attachment and information here for this university for the latest information. If no attachment is available yet, it usually means the university has not announced further details. You can download a template or sample from here . Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.
fields.requirements: Entry Requirements 1. General Requirements: (1) Non-Chinese citizens holding a valid foreign ordinary passport. (2) High school graduate (or above) with qualifications eligible for university admission. (3) Physically and mentally healthy, with no criminal record. (4) Excellent proficiency in the language of instruction. 2. Nationality Eligibility In accordance with relevant regulations, including the Nationality Law of the People's Republic of China, the Measures for the Administration of School Recruitment and Cultivation of International Students (Joint Decree No. 42 of the Ministry of Education, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, and the Ministry of Public Security), and the Notice on Regulating the Enrollment of International Students in Higher Education Institutions in China Jiao Wai Han [2020]No. 12): (1) For applicants who were born in a foreign country and held foreign nationality at birth, the applicants' parent/s (Chinese-citizen side) must have obtained foreign permanent residency before the applicants' birth. In addition, the applicant must have a record of actual residence abroad (outside Chinese mainland/HongKong/Macao/Taiwan) for at least 2 years between May 1, 2023,and April 30, 2027 (calculated in cycles from May 1 to April 30 of the following year, 9 months of actual residence per cyclecounts as one year, verified by entry/exit stamps). (2) For applicants who emigrated from China and acquired foreign nationality, the applicants must have obtained foreign nationality before May 1, 2023, and completed the procedures for renouncing Chinese nationality. In addition, the applicants must have a record of actual residence abroad (outside Chinese mainland/Hong Kong/Macao/Taiwan) for at least 2 years between May 1, 2023, and April 30, 2027 (calculated in cycles from May 1 to April 30 of the following year, 9 months of actual residence per cycle counts as one year, verified by entry/exit stamps). 3. For the required CSCA test subjects , please refer to Fudan University 2027 English-taught Undergraduate Programs . 4. Proof of English proficiency. TOEFL iBT score of ≥ 90 (New TOEFL ≥ 4.5), or IELTS ≥ 6.5, or Duolingo English Test ≥ 110, or PTE Academic ≥61. Applicants whose native language is English or who graduated from a high school fully taught in English can be exempt from this requirement. 5. (1) Color weakness and color blindness are not suitable； (2) Applicants must have excellent Maths, Physics, Chemistry and Biology background.
